_readme: REAL case studies only. Never write these with a model, and never publish a job the client has not confirmed. An entry appears on /service-areas/{area_slug}/ as 'Recent work in {City}'. Leave case_studies empty and the section simply does not render. Run scripts/case_studies_sync.py after editing. See docs/case-studies.md.
_consent: case studies describe a real job; confirm the client is OK with it being public

_schema.service_slug: optional; restricts the entry to one city x service page
_schema.title: short, factual, no superlatives — e.g. 'Burst supply line, two-story rental'
_schema.summary: 2-4 sentences in plain language: what happened, what we did, outcome. Only facts the client confirmed.
_schema.published: false keeps it staged but unrendered
